operation: the HF-08 'values / formulas' acceptance leg: one vs-TSN comparison per dataset regenerated after the double rebuild, both twins, counts unchanged
supplied_by: Claude, 2026-09-01, resuming Prompt 04 on the same branch
product_runtime_binding: `product_runtime_head` is git's own answer to 'the last commit that touched scripts/'; every file changed after it and up to the generation head is listed, and none is under scripts/, so the comparisons below ran on exactly the reviewed product runtime.
method: Per dataset the TSMIS side is resolved ONCE and hashed, so both legs provably compare the same TSMIS input. The `pre` leg builds the library with the stable-identity save OFF (pre-fix behaviour) and runs the family's registered vs-TSN comparator in mode='both'. The `post` leg rebuilds the library TWICE on the shipped path - the contract's 'after the second unchanged-raw deterministic rebuild' - and runs the SAME comparator over the SAME TSMIS input, again in mode='both'. Comparators are resolved through matrix.tsn_comparator_for, the product's own lookup, not a private table.
what_must_not_move: The comparison workbooks are NOT expected to be byte-identical between legs - the library's identity token is part of what a comparison records about its source, and moving it once is the disclosed point of the fix. What must not move is the typed truth: status, completion, verdict, pairing quality, paired and one-sided totals, differing rows, and total AND per-field differing cells. That whole typed object is compared for equality, so 'unchanged' is measured rather than asserted.

checks_applied.typed_counts_and_outcome_unchanged: the entire typed outcome - status, completion, verdict, pairing quality, duplicate group count, warning/failure counts and every count including per_field_counts - is equal between the legs
checks_applied.both_twins_present_pre/post: mode='both' produced the FORMULAS workbook and its VALUES twin in each leg; paths, sizes and SHA-256 are recorded for all four
checks_applied.values_scrape_agrees_pre/post: the published VALUES workbook's own Status/Diffs, read by header label through matrix_state.read_counts, equal the typed differing-cell and one-sided totals - the workbook self-check
checks_applied.published_comparison_trusted_pre/post: consolidation_meta.require_published_comparison accepts each result: returned typed outcome, committed generation, succeeded attempt and strict sidecar all agree
checks_applied.library_identity_moved_once: the pre-fix and post-fix artifact identity tokens differ - the disclosed one-time invalidation, measured again here
checks_applied.library_deterministic_post: post1 and post2 library bytes are identical
checks_applied.raw_manifest_unchanged: the raw source certificate is identical across the legs, so the comparison difference cannot come from a changed source

cross_run_reproducibility: The 2026-08-31 double-rebuild witness recorded each dataset's post-fix library bytes and token. This 2026-09-01 run, a separate process on a separate day from the same raw, reproduced every one of them exactly - determinism shown across sessions, not merely within one.
pre_vs_post_cell_by_cell: Beyond the typed counts, every sheet of both twins of each dataset's PRE and POST comparison workbooks was walked cell by cell (eg001_celldiff.py). Comparison, Summary, Spot Check, both Only-in sheets, both source sheets, Notes, Source Files and both hidden CMP_E2 snapshot sheets are identical; the ONLY differing cell is the Provenance row that records the TSN library's sha256 - the identity the fix moves once, by design. That is what 'counts unchanged' means here: not merely equal totals, but the same workbook apart from the cell that names the library.
